sections.heading: Earning and Redeeming Points
sections.text: Members of the Rewards program earn 1 point for every 100 spent on eligible purchases. Once a member accumulates 100 points, those points can be redeemed for a discount voucher applied to a future order; points cannot be redeemed for cash or partial vouchers below the 100 point threshold.

sections.heading: Expiry
sections.text: Points expire 18 months after they are earned if they remain unused. Redeeming even a small number of points does not reset the expiry clock on the remaining balance; each batch of earned points keeps its own 18 month expiry window from when it was earned.

sections.heading: Combining With Other Offers
sections.text: Loyalty points can be combined with seasonal promotional pricing, letting a member stack a storewide discount with a points redemption. Points cannot be combined with clearance pricing, since clearance items are excluded from most stacking rules storewide.
